classifications.rationale: The President presently exempts qualifying heavy crude oil sales from price controls (Code 3), while also directing the Secretary to conduct a later public inquiry (Code 1); these materially different postures are combined in one supplied segment.
classifications.evidence: prices charged in the first sale of heavy crude oil are exempted from price controls

classifications.rationale: The Secretary must provide an advisory recommendation and may issue implementation regulations at his discretion; the segment does not dictate a later regulatory outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Energy may pursuant to Executive Order 11790, as amended by Executive Order 12038, adopt such regulations as he deems necessary to implement this Order.
